description: Purposive (non-random) additions to the real-world corpus. Hard negatives share vocabulary with AI agents or AI services without, as far as the selector expected, using generative AI; configuration positives carry AI use mainly in infrastructure, deployment or workflow files rather than application code. The expectation recorded here guided selection only: every repository is labeled by the same blind two-annotator procedure as the sampled strata, and its expectation can turn out wrong.
